minimumSealClass.description: Optional. Seals of a lower class, or with no class, are refused with 409 `seal-class-too-low`. Left out = no minimum.

requireSecuringBeforeDoorWork.description: Optional. When true, door work starts only on a secured trailer (409 `trailer-not-secured`; ADR 0013). Left out = false.

allowHazmatOnUnclassifiedSpots.description: Optional. When true, a trailer with a hazard class may take a spot of unknown kind at a site with no HAZMAT spot (ADR 0014). Left out = false.

gate.description: The step that is refused (409 `inspection-required`, or `inspection-failed`) until a PASSED inspection of the template exists for the trailer's current visit. PRE_DOCK gates the move to a door, PRE_LOAD the start of door work on a trailer that is being loaded, PRE_DEPARTURE the check-out that takes the trailer. ON_DEMAND is never required.

purposes.description: Only visits with one of these purposes; empty = every purpose.

trailerKinds.description: Only trailers of one of these kinds; empty = every kind.

requiredInspections.description: Optional. The inspections a trailer must have PASSED, for its current visit, before the gated step (ADR 0015). A template nobody published is 422 `unknown-template`. Left out = none.
